cases.name: Nicole White
cases.narrative: On 6/20/2015, a K-9 from a volunteer search and rescue team found her severely decomposed body wrapped in a green tarp at the bottom of a wooded ravine south of Lake Kapowsin. Luminol showed blood all over his home. She had skull fractures, severe facial fractures, a fractured sternum consistent with being stomped, broken ribs and a broken arm.
